QuestInfo.name: [Alliance] The Empress's Council
QuestInfo.0: What could Neinheart be calling about?
QuestInfo.1: At the Empress's summons, you've returned to Ereve.
QuestInfo.2: Empress Cygnus worries that the enemies of Maple World are growing stronger every day. She blames herself for not having already unified the world to face the threat. What could you do to help her?
